name: source-family
title: Source Family
description: Tradition family for every source in the corpus. Decision 6 of strategy-decisions.md: no umbrella groupings — each family stands alone. Each family becomes a shelf under the Sources nav.

values.label: Abrahamic
values.description: Hebrew Bible, New Testament, mainstream Christian and Jewish primary sources.

values.label: Mormon
values.description: Book of Mormon, Doctrine and Covenants, Pearl of Great Price.

values.label: Archaeoastronomy
values.description: Serious comparative-myth + astronomy work. Includes Hancock-style works that engage the archaeoastronomy topic.

values.label: Science
values.description: Astronomy, genetics, archaeology, life sciences. Stance is 'supportive' (not neutral) for Intelligent Design / Creationism topics.

values.label: Neo-Euhemerism
values.description: Modern Ancient Astronaut Theory proponent literature (post-Sitchin). Triggered by explicit Ancient Astronauts or Neo-Euhemerism topics.

values.label: Supplementary
values.description: Films, podcasts, web archives, manifestos, fiction.
